title: Balanced sections of scalar-extended constant tensor coefficients
statement: Let k be a field, Y a scheme, g:Y → Spec(k), M a k-module, and G a Y-module. Using the constant scalar-extension tensor presheaf and scalar restriction of sections [lem-sc-picard-constant-sections-tensor-basis], there exist additive equivalences e_V: (picardConstantSectionsTensor k Y g M G)(V) ≃ M tensor_k G(V) for every open V. For every a in O_Y(V), s in M, and t in G(V), e_V(a • e_V⁻¹(s tensor t)) = s tensor (a • t). For every restriction V ⊆ U and section x over U, e_V(res(x)) = (id_M tensor res)(e_U(x)).

proof.text: Construct the pointwise scalar-extension presheaf E(V)=O_Y(V) tensor_k M with restriction on the first factor. Its Hom equivalence with maps from constant M to scalar restriction, given by evaluation at 1 tensor s and extension a tensor s ↦ a times the image of s, identifies E with the chosen pullback by uniqueness of representing objects. After tensoring this natural isomorphism with G, use the balanced maps (a tensor s) tensor t ↦ s tensor (a*t) and s tensor t ↦ (1 tensor s) tensor t. Tensor relations make the maps well-defined and tensor induction proves the inverse identities. Multiplication by a structure-ring section acts on t. Restriction acts on the ring coefficient and t, so the same formulas prove the restriction identity.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_picard_constant_tensor_balanced_sections
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (Y : Scheme.{w})
    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (M : ModuleCat.{w} k) (G : Y.Modules) :
    ∃ e : ∀ V : Y.Opens,
        (picardConstantSectionsTensor k Y g M G).obj (op V) ≃+
          (M ⊗[k] scalarObj g G (op V)),
      (∀ (V : Y.Opens) (a : Γ(Y, V)) (s : M) (t : scalarObj g G (op V)),
        e V (a • (e V).symm (s ⊗ₜ[k] t)) =
          s ⊗ₜ[k] (show scalarObj g G (op V) from a • (show G.val.obj (op V) from t))) ∧
      (∀ {U V : Y.Opensᵒᵖ} (i : U ⟶ V)
          (x : (picardConstantSectionsTensor k Y g M G).obj U),
        e V.unop ((picardConstantSectionsTensor k Y g M G).map i x) =
          ((scalarPresheaf g G ⋙ MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft M).map i) (e U.unop x))
